verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team-chat and collaboration platform, so a webhooks question is a fair one to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Its programmatic surface is Nostr relay connections over WebSocket (NIP-29/NIP-42), plus a CLI and workflow triggers. Those are adjacent event or automation mechanisms, not webhooks a programmatic consumer can register and receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
